title: Patch: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes II
notes: The designer's second Stinkyscape+ balance pass (#3996). Costs, stats and numbers on 25 cards; script changes, each keeping its v0.6.5b script (R767000), on Profe Yates, Drone Assembler v4 and v5, Fire Beam v5, Taotie, House Party, In a hurry, Endless Expedition, Feng Shui, Core Researcher, Legacy: Snom Bunny Mind Control, Occidentless Mandate, Tommy Tempo, Jlockeed Shredder-12, ZolarKeth, Legacy: Jlockeed's Weapons, First Day of Xuexiao, Phase Fabric, Call to Chaos (Mindustrial-Swarm Edition) and Appropriations; Icarus gains Immune to Spells. Rulings R3996000-R3996002, R3996100, R3996101, R3996200-R3996202.

changes: Profe Yates's Cry exiles one permanent you choose, then summons its Traps, and all three of its Activates are always available.
Drone Assembler v5: Activate 2: summon a Drone Interceptor (Radiant: a Radiant one) to attack an enemy, with an extra turn of cooldown. It summoned a Drone Corvette.
Drone Assembler v4: Activate: summon a Drone Interceptor to attack an enemy, once a turn with an extra turn of cooldown, instead of twice a turn.
Fire Beam v5 Burns 6 on both faces; the base face activates once a turn, the Radiant face twice.
饕餮 is 2/2 (Radiant 4/4): Activate: fuse a random enemy Unit into it, then Freeze it (the Radiant face doesn't Freeze). It fused at the end of your turn.
Tommy Tempo's Cry gains +1 Health (Radiant +2) per mana lost, no longer Attack.
Core Researcher adds its Drone Core cards on its Death instead of its Cry.
House Party costs (3), down from (4); its Right-house defenders and their Reborn copies have Brittle 1.
Occidentless Mandate no longer adds CN cards to your hand; the Radiant face exiles only enemy permanents.
Legacy: Jlockeed's Weapons no longer gives Rush.
First Day of 学校 adds 3 random CN cards, up from 2, at their printed cost.
Legacy: Snom Bunny Mind Control costs (3): steal an enemy Unit; next turn you lose 2 mana (Radiant 1).
Endless Expedition: now and at the start of each of your turns for the rest of the game, add a random Terminus card that costs (2) to your hand. It no longer costs you mana.
Feng Shui costs (3), up from (2), and gains Cry: add an Auspicious Rock (Radiant: a Radiant one) to your hand.
In a hurry fills your board with Rush Tokens instead of summoning 4.
